item: Today's publication times survive trafilatura 2.4.0 (max_date stated as the end of today, never popped)
summary: trafilatura 2.4.0 merges a supplied date_config over its defaults, so the popped max_date came back as today 00:00 and every time stated later today fell back to midnight (core-only CI installs the newest release and went red; reproduced locally with 2.4.0). _date_params now sets max_date to the end of today, htmldate's own default; passes on 2.3.1 and 2.4.0.
